# Aṭṭhakanipāta (AN 8)

**ID:** AN 8  
**Section:** Aṅguttaranikāya (an)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Aṭṭhakanipāta

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Notable discourses include the *Uposathasutta* (AN 8.20), treating the suspension of the monastic Observance [Lueritthikul 2015]; the *Gotamīsutta* (AN 8.51), concerning Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī's request for ordination and the eight *garudhammas* [Anālayo 2011; Anālayo 2016]; and the *Bhūmicālasutta* (AN 8.70), presenting the eight causes of earthquakes [Walshe 1987].

Curated records list parallels for all 73 suttas across early canonical corpora, including 16 in the Chinese *Madhyama-āgama*, 13 individual Chinese translations, 10 in other Pali texts, 9 in the *Ekottarika-āgama*, and 14 across *Saṃyuktāgama* collections (T 99 and T 100), in addition to Sanskrit and Tibetan Vinaya parallels for texts like the *Uposathasutta* and *Gotamīsutta* [Lueritthikul 2015; Anālayo 2011; Anālayo 2016].
